Subject: RFP 2026-042 — DPA and security evidence request

Hi Sean,

Thanks for responding to our RFP for the Public Works telemetry project. As part of the procurement packet we need the following to complete the security & privacy evaluation: a signed Data Processing Annex (or your standard DPA), a SOC 2 summary / mapping to controls, completed CAIQ export (or equivalent CAIQ/Cloud security questionnaire), and SIG-Lite responses where applicable.

Additional notes:
- The contracting authority is treating this as FedRAMP-adjacent; while not a FedRAMP system, we need documentation that maps controls to FedRAMP-equivalent requirements.
- Please indicate whether Redwood will process any health-related data (HIPAA scope) under this engagement — the RFP includes a section for DPIA/health data handling.
- We have an internal deadline to complete reviews by July 22.

Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA for the attachments? If you have a redlined DPA workflow (DocuSign preferred) that speeds review, please include.

Thanks,

Maya Rodriguez

Hi Maya — thanks for the clarity and the timeline. We can provide the items you listed. High-level plan:

1) SOC 2 summary & control mapping (PDF) — we will provide our latest attestation summary and a short mapping table to the FedRAMP-equivalent families by EOD Monday (7/13).
2) DPA: we'll provide our standard Data Processing Annex (editable .docx) and a DocuSign workflow for signature; we typically accept SCCs language where required but may need to confirm scope for HIPAA.
3) CAIQ & SIG-Lite: we'll attach our CAIQ export and a completed SIG-Lite workbook; if you have specific control rows you want expanded we can annotate.
4) DPIA/health-data clarifications: quick answer — Redwood does not ingest protected health identifiers by default for this project, but customers can send PHI if they choose; we need to understand the processing flows to confirm HIPAA obligations.

I'll loop in our legal and security leads to produce the attachments and a short set of DPIA notes. Expect the first bundle by 7/13; final DPA (for signature) by 7/15.

Best,
Sean
